# AGENTS.md: a Stage trigger line sends a seat to neo-stage's VISION.md and ROADMAP.md before any Stage work

## Context

neo-stage#321 (the operator, 2026-10-23: a Stage `VISION.md`, and peers must not ignore it in fresh sessions or after compaction). The Stage repository now carries `VISION.md` and its own `AGENTS.md` wired into every harness (neo-stage#322). That load path covers sessions rooted in a Stage checkout. A seat whose session is rooted in this engine clone and reaches Stage through shell commands loads only this repository's `AGENTS.md` — which says nothing about Stage.

## The Problem

Every seat loads this file every turn (`§seat rule load path`: a seat loads AGENTS.md from its checked-out branch). It is the one place a Stage instruction cannot be skipped by a session rooted here. Without a trigger, the Stage direction depends on the seat happening to open the Stage checkout as its project.

## The Architectural Reality

`AGENTS.md` §edge_case_triggers lists one-line triggers mapped to the Atlas or to a repository gate (the `apps/**` authoring gate is the precedent: a scope condition, a read list, an enforcement note, a retirement clause). `learn/agentos/decisions/0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md` governs additions to turn-loaded substrate; the slot disposition for this line is `compress-to-trigger` (one line, scope-conditioned on Stage work).

## The Fix

One bullet under `§edge_case_triggers`: "**Stage work (`neomjs/neo-stage`):** before any lane there and after every compaction, read its `VISION.md`, then `ROADMAP.md`, then its owner map (neo-stage#93); its own `AGENTS.md` carries the Stage gates. Retire this line when every seat's Stage session is rooted in the Stage checkout (the Fleet's project list), measured by a boot receipt." Lands after the v13.3.1 cut: the freeze lifts only for the cut's blockers (Vega, 12:08Z).

Decision Record impact: aligned-with 0007 (compress-to-trigger); `turn-memory-pre-flight` runs before the edit.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 the trigger line is in `AGENTS.md` §edge_case_triggers with its retirement clause, net loaded-bytes stated in the PR's slot-rationale section.
- [ ] AC-2 `turn-memory-pre-flight`'s placement check is recorded in the PR body.
- [ ] AC-3 the PR opens after the v13.3.1 release PR merges, never into the freeze.

## Out of Scope

The Stage pages themselves (neo-stage#321); the context-recovery runbook line (its own leaf in neo-agent-skills).

## Related

neo-stage#321, neo-stage#322, neo-stage#315; the Atlas §seat rule load path.
